energyScale.basis: Curatorial judgment, not measured audio features. A typical level is not a rule for every recording or audience.

directions.name: Funk and rhythmic dance
signals: A guest asks to sustain a dance groove: keep rhythmic continuity across the next two or three songs.
An artist block is explicitly requested: choose unplayed compatible recordings, then respond to any newer direction.
searches: Kool & The Gang Get Down On It

directions.name: Guitar-driven party music
signals: The guest promotes an energetic guitar song: protect its turn and choose a similarly direct next recording.
A quieter older request is waiting: plan a recognisable transition after the current energetic block instead of forgetting it.
searches: Film Zamisli život u ritmu muzike za ples
AC/DC You Shook Me All Night Long

directions.name: Synthpop and familiar electronic pop
signals: The room asks for familiar dance refrains: choose a recognisable vocal over a steady electronic rhythm.
A previous song in the same style already played: find a fresh title rather than a new remaster URI.
searches: ET Da ti nisam bila dovoljna
The Human League Don't You Want Me

directions.name: Melodic regional and familiar pop
signals: The guest chooses a familiar melodic pop song: continue its vocal warmth without assuming the whole room wants a slow set.
The explicit queue has been cleared: follow the new selections and build a fresh short continuation.

directions.name: Communal singalong
signals: Guests report singing together: choose familiar unplayed refrains and leave room for the voices.
A dedication is requested: identify the intended person and recording while keeping ordinary playback continuous during preparation.
searches: Novi Fosili Za dobra stara vremena

directions.name: Comic and exuberant party songs
signals: Guests explicitly turn toward playful or comic songs: sustain the exuberance with related choices.
A comic song has a different stylistic edge: check the host's genre and explicit-content boundaries before treating it as permission for a broader change.
searches: Dreletronic Vumrl mi je pajcek moj

directions.name: Warm or reflective interlude
signals: The host asks for a breather or softer emotional passage: lower intensity through a familiar transition.
Chat is merely quiet: do not infer that a quieter interlude is wanted without another signal.
searches: Ben E. King Stand By Me

directions.name: International disco and pop dance
signals: The audience asks for wider familiar dance music: use a strong chorus to connect the current groove to a different language or era.
The audience requested a specific regional artist block: preserve that request rather than substituting this direction automatically.
searches: Moloko Sing It Back Boris Musical Mix Edit

directions.name: Club electronics
signals: Guests explicitly want a stronger continuous dance pulse: maintain it across the short next-song front.
A candidate has an extended introduction or long club version: compare its duration and arrangement with the audience's requested pace.
searches: The Chemical Brothers Hey Boy Hey Girl

directions.name: Hip-hop and R&B party rhythm
signals: Guests ask for rap or R&B: choose a recognisable rhythmic connection from the current song.
Check the selected recording's explicit flag and the host's preferences; an artist name does not determine whether this recording fits.
searches: Missy Elliott Get Ur Freak On

directions.name: Latin and global dance pop
signals: Guests request a Latin or global dance turn: use a familiar rhythmic transition and observe the next response.
Do not assume language or nationality from the people in the room; use their requests and reactions.
searches: Celia Cruz La Vida Es Un Carnaval

directions.name: Regional folk and pop crossover
signals: A guest explicitly selects a crossover song: preserve that turn, then judge the next move from their actual direction.
A host sets a hard limit on further folk influence: stop expansion into this direction and choose permitted adjacent material.
searches: Željko Bebek Sinoć sam pola kafane popio
